items.title: Hackathon Winner (2nd place) — Cursor × Tec Guatemala
items.blurb: Top 2 of ~10 teams in 4 hours: browser-based AR sky telescope.
body: Second place at Cursor Hackathon Guatemala (4-hour sprint) with El Telescopio Digital / Sextant: a phone as a live sky telescope.
In one afternoon, a production web demo tracking the ISS and Hubble in real time (orbits + NASA/NORAD data), driven by camera, gyroscope, and GPS — fully client-side, no backend.

items.title: Travel Grant — Cursor Buildathon San Salvador
items.blurb: Travel grant to represent Guatemala at a 24 h AI-first buildathon.
body: Travel grant from the502project for the Cursor Buildathon in San Salvador.
Selected to represent the local community and build with AI-assisted tools under time pressure (Shoot AI).

items.title: Hackathon SemiFinalist — INNOVATECH 2026
items.blurb: Q-Pay (Qubity): P2P lending; 100+ waitlist in under a week.
body: Semifinalists with Q-Pay: a P2P lending app aimed at cutting friction around promissory notes (with Qubity).
Fast demand signal: 100+ waitlist in under a week, also competing against local startups.

items.title: Hackathon Winner (1st Place) — UFM Computer Science Hackathon
items.blurb: 1st place with Aprendi: adaptive learning and Linux labs.
body: 1st place with Aprendi (Qubity): a platform that personalizes learning paths from live performance.
Intensive sprint: from idea to usable product with interactive Linux labs.

items.title: Hackathon Finalist (Top 5) — Atom Dev Day
items.blurb: Top 5 in ~8–12 h with Agent Builder: sales agents with LLM + RAG.
body: Top 5 at Atom Dev Day (~8–12 h) with Agent Builder: a platform to assemble sales agents with LLM + RAG.
Proof of execution under pressure: idea to usable demo in a single sprint.

items.title: Guatemala Honorific Mention — Global Connection Award
items.blurb: Global Connection mention for Guatemala; deliverable: Astro Tracker (48 h MVP).
body: Honorific mention (Global Connection) for Guatemala at the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
Deliverable: Astro Tracker — asteroid-impact simulation with NASA data, built as a 48-hour MVP.

items.title: Leadership Award
items.blurb: Full scholarship to an intensive leadership program for academic excellence.
body: Full scholarship to an intensive leadership program for outstanding academics and a top-tier GPA.
Selected for initiative, peer influence, and commitment to technical work and community during technical high school.
